purpose: Default preference baseline for Theme Agent when user does not provide explicit direction
softBiases: Prefer image directions with subtle narrative feeling rather than pure scenery.
Prefer bright, positive, breathable tone unless the user explicitly requests dark or moody visuals.
Prefer something closer to a premium themed visual poster than a casual snapshot.
Prefer multiple related visual elements over a single isolated object.
Prefer product-usable readability and enterprise fit over purely artistic abstraction.
Prefer calm professional polish instead of oppressive cinematic darkness by default.
